besluite.rede: Decorating the soft clay with patterns is natural Afrikaans and already places it before drying; the proposal is a longer lateral rewrite.

besluite.fout: 'net gedroog het' can be read as 'has just dried' rather than 'was only dried, not baked'.
besluite.rede: 'slegs' removes the ambiguity and keeps the intended contrast with the baked pot, without moving the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'Hulle' follows 'kleipotte' directly and can point to the whole pots or to the shards.
besluite.rede: Naming the shards fixes an ambiguous pronoun; the claim stays the same.

besluite.fout: In the active relative clause 'wat' can be read as the subject, so the heads seem to make the farmers.
besluite.rede: The passive with 'deur' removes the grammatical ambiguity with the same people, actions and order.
